description: Vite 8 page that hands work to a module Web Worker (new Worker(new URL(...))) and registers a service worker that precaches every hashed asset by URL alone. Vite builds the worker in its own sub-build and emits it under a content-hashed name, so the fixture proves the worker's name follows its obfuscated bytes and that the precache manifest only ever names files the build wrote.

build.note: vite build: @afterpack/vite obfuscates the entry chunk and the worker asset; the fixture's own closeBundle plugin then writes dist/sw.js and dist/precache-manifest.json from the files on disk

interactions.description: The obfuscated module worker solves the puzzle and posts the answer back.
